title: LCARS Project Intensity v1
description: Structural schema for a per-project intensity.json (template: priv/cap_profile/canon/config/intensity-template.json). The LEVEL is the HUMAN's declaration (elicited by the framing interview — stakes of failure, lifetime; an agent NEVER self-assesses criticality) relayed by the architect; justification carries the WHY in prose. pipeline_default names the validation card. Underscore-prefixed keys are informational and ignored by the runtime.

nature.description: Optional project domain hint (e.g. web-gui, hardware, generic) — informs card selection at declaration time; the runtime only reads pipeline_default.
